# vyos.blueprints.isis

IS-IS and segment routing (docs blueprint "Segment-routing IS-IS example")

- Configures the IS-IS process (NET, level, metric style), interfaces (passive, point-to-point, metric), redistribution, MPLS segment routing (maximum label depth, global/local blocks, prefix SIDs) and the interfaces MPLS is enabled on.
- Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no IS-IS or MPLS module.
- Loopback (dummy) and link addressing and MTU belong to `vyos.blueprints.base`.
- MPLS forwarding needs the kernel MPLS modules (mpls_router, mpls_iptunnel).

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.isis
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `isis_net` | str |  | `''` | Network entity title, e.g. `49.0000.0000.0000.0001.00`. Nothing is configured when empty. |
| `isis_level` | str |  | `''` | IS-IS level. |
| `isis_metric_style` | str |  | `''` | Metric style. |
| `isis_log_adjacency_changes` | bool |  | `false` | Log adjacency changes. |
| `isis_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | IS-IS interfaces. |
| `isis_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | Interface, e.g. `eth1` or `dum0`. |
| `isis_interfaces.passive` | bool |  | `false` | Advertise but do not form adjacencies (loopbacks). |
| `isis_interfaces.network` | str |  |  | Network type. |
| `isis_interfaces.metric` | int |  |  | Interface metric. |
| `isis_redistribute` | list |  | `[]` | Redistribution into IS-IS (IPv4). |
| `isis_redistribute.type` | str | yes |  | Route type, e.g. `connected`. |
| `isis_redistribute.level` | str |  | `level-2` | Level the routes are redistributed into. |
| `isis_segment_routing` | dict |  | `{}` | MPLS segment routing. |
| `isis_segment_routing.maximum_label_depth` | int |  |  | Maximum SID depth (MSD). |
| `isis_segment_routing.global_block` | dict |  |  | SRGB, e.g. `{low: 16000, high: 23999}`. |
| `isis_segment_routing.local_block` | dict |  |  | SRLB, e.g. `{low: 15000, high: 15999}`. |
| `isis_segment_routing.prefixes` | list |  | `[]` | Prefix SIDs. |
| `isis_segment_routing.prefixes.prefix` | str | yes |  | Prefix, usually the loopback, e.g. `192.0.2.1/32`. |
| `isis_segment_routing.prefixes.index` | int | yes |  | SID index. |
| `isis_mpls_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Interfaces MPLS forwarding is enabled on (`protocols mpls interface`). |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks an Up adjacency on every non-passive interface and, with segment routing, SR entries in the MPLS table.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `isis_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
| `isis_segment_routing` | dict |  | `{}` | Same value as for `main`. |
